name: A Strong Britain in an Age of Uncertainty: The National Security Strategy (2010)
description: United Kingdom 2010 National Security Strategy (Cm 7953), elevating hostile cyber attacks to a Tier One risk to UK national security.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines UK national cyber resilience, critical national infrastructure protection, and public-sector security architecture expectations.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses UK strategic advantage in science and technology, AI security, and cyber power.
